title: Exit monitors are keyed by chain and token, so a second open trade of the same token replaces the first trade's monitor and baseline

evidence.note: registerExitMonitor clears any existing timers under chain:token and stores only the new interval
startExitMonitor registers per chain:token, not per tradeId (also :2044)
teardownGenuineClose marks every pending row of the token sold but deletes only its own tradeId exit_state row
partial amounts come from the surviving trade state originalTokenAmount only

sibling_sites_checked: All per-token keyed state: sell lock, position queue, timer registry (exitManager.ts), routine pause set (:644). A second open trade of one token on one chain is reachable through the double-buy race (AUD-BUY-004) or through a re-buy while a failed-held position is open. The full sell sells the whole balance, so both trades exit together; partial tiers and the stop/trailing baseline follow only the newer trade.
severity_rationale: S2: needs two open trades of one token (itself a BUY S1 defect). Effect is wrong exit sizing and baselines plus an orphaned exit_state row, not a strand.
recommendation: Fix at the source (one open position per token, card BUY-03); if two trades can coexist, key monitors by tradeId. Phase 24 with AUD-BUY-004.
